audit.why: HARD 8/10 is right: assassin who dodges TF's only CC with a 16s untargetable hop; TF plays for map post-6. WinRate 49.92 over 3267 games supports near-even-but-hard framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chum the Waters described as a point-and-click suppress and Fizz's passive as true damage. Kit: R is a 1300-range thrown skillshot (projectile, blockable) that attaches on contact, slows, then knocks up; passive is unit-walking plus flat damage reduction, no true damage. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; missing the Seastone Trident auto-reset burst tell.
audit.why: enemyKit text and flags: R projectile+knockup+slow, no suppression anywhere; P 'takes a flat amount of reduced damage'. E 16/14/12/10/8s, R 120/100/80s, Q 8-6s at 550 range.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, whys[4], wants.foe[2] and enemyWin rewritten to slow-then-knockup skillshot; cooldowns field now carries 16s/8s E and 120s R numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both suspectNames are false positives: 'Gold Card' is TF's own W card and 'Chum the Waters' is Fizz's real R name.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus a card cycle trade back — but only when his 16s Playful/Trickster is spent.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, hold yellow until his E (16s early) is spent, and the window stays even.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Late it's your positioning against his R-Q dive from fog: split R-safe, or hold Destiny to spot his flank first.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Playful/Trickster is 16s at rank 1, 8s max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; once baited you own a long window. - Chum the Waters is 120s at rank 1 — post-6, ask where it is before every step. - Yellow card is the lifeline; never throw it into a raised E.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your yellow card with Playful/Trickster, then landing Chum the Waters — the shark's knockup deletes your escape.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: A freeze near your tower drags him past river into gank range — Q the far minions and let the yellow card price his dives.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Plate greed with no yellow card up is an Urchin Strike invitation — his W auto-reset burst starts at 550 range; wait out Pick A Card.

edits.before: Chum the Waters at 6 suppresses your escape and one-shots you through your Gold Card timing.
edits.after: Chum the Waters at 6 slows, then knocks you up — the attached fish makes his dive near-guaranteed.

edits.before: Chum the Waters plus E is a point-and-click kill onto you: the shark suppresses your escape and his passive true-damage burst deletes squishies. Hold Gate/Flash strictly for his ult and don't shove past river without vision.
edits.after: Chum the Waters attaches on contact: the fish slows you, then the shark knocks you up while his Q-W burst follows. Sidestep the thrown fish, hold Gate/Flash strictly for his ult, and don't shove past river without vision.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 read as skill only because your shove-and-roam can offset him if you never waste Gold Card into his E-dodge. At 6 he is firmly ahead: Chum the Waters plus his true-damage passive is a point-and-click execute that suppresses your escape and beats your Gold Card cast time.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 read as skill only because your shove-and-roam can offset him if you never waste Gold Card into his E-dodge. At 6 he is firmly ahead: Chum the Waters is a 1300-range skillshot that slows on attach and knocks you up — one landed fish plus his Q-W burst beats your Gold Card cast.

edits.before: Land Chum the Waters to suppress and one-shot you at 6
edits.after: Land Chum the Waters to knock you up and one-shot you at 6

notes: Both packet suspectNames are false positives (Gold Card = TF W card; Chum the Waters = real R name).
